title.en: Deploy Azure Machine learning workspace in secondary region

summary.en: If your primary workspace is unavailable, switch to the secondary workspace to continue work. Azure Machine Learning doesn't auto-submit jobs to the secondary workspace during an outage. Update your code configuration to point to the new workspace resource.

rationale.en: A second region reduces dependence on one regional deployment only when traffic can reach it and its state, identity, network and capacity are usable. The routing decision and the readiness evidence are separate from merely creating another resource.
rationale.ko: 두 번째 지역은 트래픽이 도달하고 데이터, 신원, 네트워크, 용량을 사용할 수 있어야 복구에 도움이 됩니다. 리소스를 하나 더 만드는 작업과 라우팅 전환, 준비 상태 확인은 서로 다른 절차입니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces. Specific focus: Secondary ML workspace.
Apply when the workload's regional outage objectives justify an independent regional deployment; identify data-loss and recovery-time limits first.
applicability.ko: 지역 장애 목표에 따라 독립적인 지역 배포가 필요한 워크로드에 적용합니다. 먼저 허용 가능한 데이터 손실과 복구 시간을 정합니다.

applicability.en: ML workspace metadata, registry artifacts, training checkpoints, serving endpoints and regional compute quota have different recovery requirements.
applicability.ko: ML 작업 영역 메타데이터, 레지스트리 아티팩트, 학습 체크포인트, 처리 엔드포인트와 지역 컴퓨팅 할당량은 복구 조건이 다릅니다.

before.en: Traffic and required dependencies can rely on a single regional path, with no demonstrated alternate-region readiness.
before.ko: 트래픽과 필수 의존 리소스가 한 지역 경로에 의존하고, 대체 지역의 준비 상태는 확인되지 않았을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Secondary workspace, data, identity and model dependencies recreated and reachable. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: Primary and secondary regional paths have explicit routing, compatible dependencies and recorded readiness criteria.

Choose the supported regional pattern, prepare independent dependencies and capacity, and define the traffic-switch and failback procedure including state reconciliation.

title.en: Provision recommended storage configuration on database VMs

summary.en: Ensure optimal disk types and configurations for data and log volumes, meeting IOPS and throughput requirements. Follow Microsoft's recommendations for disk caching, WriteAccelerator, stripe size, and Linux I/O Scheduler. Use SAP on Azure QualityCheck tool to identify deviations.

benefits.en: Improve reliability, performance and optimize costs

rationale.en: Storage placement determines persistence, sharing, throughput and failure coupling. Shared, ephemeral, OS, data and profile storage have different semantics; use the supported layout for the exact workload rather than applying one disk rule everywhere.
rationale.ko: 저장 위치는 영속성, 공유, 처리량과 장애 결합을 결정합니다. 공유, 임시, OS, 데이터와 프로필 저장소는 의미가 다르므로 하나의 디스크 규칙을 모두에 적용하지 말고 정확한 워크로드가 지원하는 배치를 사용합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions. Specific focus: SAP database disk layout.
Review the actual data type, durability requirement, sharing and fencing model and supported client or VM configuration.
applicability.ko: 실제 데이터 종류, 내구성 요구, 공유와 펜싱 방식, 지원 클라이언트 또는 VM 구성을 검토합니다.

applicability.en: Use the supported SAP, OS and database HA design. Synchronous local HA, asynchronous DR, fencing, load-balancer probes and shared files are not interchangeable.

title.en: RE:08 Design a reliability testing strategy

summary.en: Test resiliency and availability scenarios by applying the principles of chaos engineering in your test and production environments. Use testing to ensure that your graceful degradation implementation and scaling strategies are effective by performing active malfunction and simulated load testing.

rationale.en: A recovery feature is useful only if the intended state can be restored and the workload works afterward. An isolated recovery exercise distinguishes configuration eligibility from actual recovery-point access, boot, data integrity and application performance.
